title: A Gauge Invariant Metric of Randers Spacetime
content: The equation of motion of a charged point particle can be interpreted as a geodesic equation in Randers spacetime, which is a generalization of Riemannian space. However, a well known issue with Randers spacetime is that its metric is not gauge invariant. Thus, it cannot be used to calculate the distance between two different points in spacetime. In this study, we try to introduce a method to construct a gauge invariant metric for Randers spacetime. This may contribute to the geometrization of the electromagnetic force and thus aid in the study of unified field theory. Furthermore, we propose a possible experimental approach to test the results.
